validationRules: Event identity match: Snapshot match_id must strictly match bet match_id
Innings number match: Market innings parameter must match snapshot innings
Target index match: Over number or wicket number must match query parameter exactly
Completeness check: Incomplete or mid-over partial scores must be rejected
Double-entry delta validation: Runs in over = over_end_score - previous_over_end_score
Cryptographic binding: Authorization token binds SHA-256 evidence hash of betId + matchId + marketId + outcome
